The checker directly enumerated 5163 matrices over five finite fields in twelve instances, including the extension field F4, and tested polynomial identities. The general statement is established by argument, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: A natural invariant of two elementary generators in finite classical groups is the full conjugacy law of their group commutator. The result determines it for every finite field and dimension, distinguishes identity/unipotent/semisimple/repeated eigenvalue classes, yields a sharp parity-characteristic transition, and has nontrivial dimension-stable limits. It goes beyond an isolated parameter substitution or class-existence check.
